neighbours.label: Words of the 'summar-', 'sum', 'conclus-' and 'resum-' families when opening a summing-up ('When summarizing', 'to summarise', 'in sum', 'En conclusión', 'En resumen'); other openers stay low, and ' summary' as a plain noun reads lower.
fire: Como conclusión, el estudio no halló diferencias.
When summarizing the main points, she paused.
The results agree; to summarise, it works.
So in sum, the plan failed for three reasons.
En resumen, los precios subieron este año.
To sum up, we need more time.
In summary, the drug appears to be safe.
Por conclusión podemos decir que funciona.
quiet: Como resultado, el estudio no halló diferencias.
When discussing the main points, she paused.
The results agree; to be fair, it works.
So in fact, the plan failed for three reasons.
En España, los precios subieron este año.
To begin with, we need more time.
In mice, the drug appears to be safe.
A summary of the main points is provided.

short: summar-, conclus- words opening a summing-up
notes: Probes: 0.37-0.89; noun or button 'summary' 0.19-0.26, 'In short' 0.24, 'To conclude' 0.13 (so not every synonym). 'In studying' 0.03. Near misses keep the frames; one tests the plain noun. Other summing-up words are weak ('In short', 'To conclude'), so it is a family of stems, not the concept.
